ukraine.title: Flag of Ukraine

colors.note: Represents the sky, peace, and truth

desc: - Two equal horizontal bands of blue over yellow, adopted on 28 January 1992 after independence
- The colours symbolise the clear blue sky above golden wheat fields
trivia:
- The blue represents the sky; the yellow represents wheat and the nation's agricultural wealth
- The colours were formally adopted in 1996 after Ukrainian independence from the Soviet Union
- Ukraine's flag has been used since medieval times but was suppressed during Soviet rule
